A Quiet Channel

A midnight phone call, a hotel room and a document that officially does not exist. Two governments that do not speak, in six parts: listen, complete each document in your head, answer the questions, and use the transcript only at the end.

6 parts About 5 min 20 questions British & American English
1Press play and listen to the whole part. Don’t worry about every word.
2Answer the questions. Use the colored lines on the bar to replay any sentence.
3When you finish, open the Transcript and check what you missed.
